business_summary: LAPLACE Renewable Energy Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of thermal processes, coatings, and related automated equipment for photovoltaic cell manufacturing in China and internationally. The company offers thermal process equipment used in boron diffusion, phosphorus diffusion, oxidation, and annealing equipment; and coating equipment, including low pressure chemical vapor, plasma-enhanced chemical vapor, atomic layer, and atomic layer edge passivation deposition equipment products. It also provides photovoltaic equipment, such as laser equipment, cell gap film application machines, and testing instruments; semiconductor discrete device equipment, including oxidation, annealing, and coating equipment; and supporting products and services. In addition, the company offers solar cells, such as cell laser contact opening, low pressure chemical vapor deposition, low pressure oxidation/annealing system, low pressure horizontal placement boron diffusion equipment, low pressure POCL Diffusion, atomic layer deposition system, atomic edge passivation deposition complete solution, laser induced metallization equipment, poly thickness reduction through laser Abl/ laser induced oxidation, and plasma enhanced chemical vapor deposition; reflective film layup; load-and-unload automations; hidden crack, basket fragment, quartz boat fragment, graphite boat fragment, sheet resistance, reflectivity, film thickness, ellipsometry film thickness, in-line thickness, PL, AOI, EPL, IV and EL, and laser spot detectors; and silicon carbide integrated boat support, SIC boat, SIC jig, heating element, and coated quartz tube, as well as semiconductor equipment. LAPLACE Renewable Energy Technology Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
business_summary_ko: LAPLACE Renewable Energy Technology Co., Ltd.는 중국 및 해외에서 광전지 제조를 위한 열 공정, 코팅 및 관련 자동화 장비의 연구, 개발, 생산 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 붕소 확산, 인 확산, 산화 및 어닐링 장비에 사용되는 열 공정 장비를 제공합니다. 저압 화학 증기, 플라즈마 강화 화학 증기, 원자층 및 원자층 엣지 패시베이션 증착 장비 제품을 포함한 코팅 장비. 또한 레이저 장비, 셀 갭 필름 응용 기계 및 테스트 장비와 같은 광전지 장비를 제공합니다. 산화, 어닐링, 코팅 장비를 포함한 반도체 개별 장치 장비; 제품과 서비스를 지원합니다. 또한, 회사는 셀 레이저 접촉 개방, 저압 화학 기상 증착, 저압 산화/어닐링 시스템, 저압 수평 배치 붕소 확산 장비, 저압 POCL 확산, 원자층 증착 시스템, 원자 모서리 패시베이션 증착 완전한 솔루션, 레이저 유도 금속화 장비, 폴리 두께 감소 등의 태양 전지를 제공합니다.
